narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 2, 2024, at approximately 0715 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered two men waiting at a bus stop in Holland, Michigan. Both stated that they are citizens of Honduras without documents.
INTERVIEWS:
The subject of this record, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that he crossed the river near McAllen, Texas, in April 2021.
His companion, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that he crossed near Eagle Pass in 2017 and is documented on a separate record.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Both men were processed for Notices to Appear.
